introHtml: Uni Ball portfolios combine the trusted quality of Uni Ball pens with professional organization. Ideal for corporate training kits, client gifts, or employee onboarding, these portfolios feature durable construction and a sleek design that holds standard notepads. Choose from various colors and add your logo with foil stamping or screen printing for a polished look that reinforces your brand at every meeting.
